overall: Record holds up: 12 of 13 rows confirmed, 1 discrepancy. Every VERIFIED probe reached its expected text; WebFetch probes ran on statutes, constitution and case rows, and script probes on the rest. Generalisation worked for statutes (23 V.S.A. § 1201, both hosts), session laws (2019 No. 131), promulgated orders (V.R.Cr.P. 49), LII CVR (04-000-001), opinions (25-AP-423) and Justia pre-2021 slugs (2019-045). Problems: (1) subsequent-history wrongly says trial dockets are not indexed; they are indexed unpadded ('25-cv-1449'). (2) The V.S.A. appendices are claimed in coverage but have no regex or URL rule. (3) The regex misreads '§§ 1201-1205' as a section. (4) The promulgated-slug derivation rule is inexact. Lexis rows: link-only, empty, as reported.
